maidgap.gui.pickup_tip: Click to cycle. Terminal clicks take this many items; the maid also moves at most this many per source slot each cycle. Stored on the gap, applies live
maidgap.gui.refill_tip: For YOU (the player): when on, items in your inventory at or below the threshold (default 8) are automatically topped up to a full stack every 2 seconds from bound containers; even items used up completely (0 left) get a fresh stack pulled back. Binding sources include gaps you carry AND gaps worn in a maid's bauble slot within 96 blocks - no need to take the gap off her. Note: you must be near the container (same dimension, within bind range) for refills to work; up to 3 item types per scan. Tune threshold/interval in maid_gap_enhanced-common.toml
